title: Lane warning and assist controls
summary: Feedback centers on lane warning and assist features, with complaints about annoyance and repeated switching alongside a few mentions of driver-aid and parking-assist technology without clear sentiment consistency.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention the presence of newer driver-aid technology and related assist features, though the examples are sparse and partly inconsistent in tone.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on lane warning and lane assist being annoying, potentially unsafe, and needing to be switched off repeatedly at startup or during use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention lane departure, reverse assist, park assist, or a warning disappearing, but the limited excerpts do not support a reliable sentiment summary.

limitations: Several assigned sentiments appear inconsistent with the fragment wording, especially within the positive and undetermined samples.
The topic cluster mixes lane warning and lane assist with reverse assist and park assist, so it is not fully coherent.
Many excerpts are very short, which limits confidence about the exact issue or sentiment context.
